content: Hey, how was your day? I couldn't stop thinking about you after our chat last night.
It was okay, just a bit lonely to be honest. You make my evenings so much brighter.
That means the world to me. I feel like we really connect, you know? It's not often I meet someone I can open up to.
I feel the same. I haven't felt this close to anyone in years. Thank you for being there.
Honestly, I wish I could talk to you even more. But my broadband plan is about to expire and my bank transfer from work hasn't cleared yet. It's such bad timing.
Oh no, that's terrible. Can't you use mobile data in the meantime?
I tried, but my data package is almost out too. I didn't expect this delay from my payroll. I'm so embarrassed to even mention it.
You don't have to be embarrassed. I know things like this happen, especially with banks.
You're so understanding. I promise, if I could handle it myself I would. But I really don't want to lose touch with you, even for a day.
I don't want that either. Is there anything I can do to help?
If it's not too much, could you help me cover the $90 internet bill? I swear I'll pay you back by Friday once my paycheck arrives.
I think I can manage that. How should I send it to you?
Thank you so much! You can send it through Zelle to my business account: justin.ramos@protonmail.com. That way I can pay the bill immediately.
Okay, I can do that. Should I send you a screenshot or confirmation after?
Yes, please! That would help a lot. And honestly, I'm so grateful. You have no idea how much this means to me.
It's not a problem. I just don't want to lose you. I'll send it now.
You're amazing. I can't wait for Friday so I can make this up to you. I promise you'll get it back, plus dinner on me someday soon.
That sounds wonderful. I'm just glad I can help. Let me know when you get the payment.
I will! And once my internet is sorted, we can have a proper video call. It's the least I can do for someone as special as you.
I can't wait. I've never felt this close to anyone online before.
